SYSTEM_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Cockpit/console login password for SYSTEM_ADMIN_USER (or root if unset)

SYSTEM_ADMIN_SSH_KEY.description: Public key to authorize for SYSTEM_ADMIN_USER and root

SYSTEM_INTERNAL_INTERFACE.description: Interface carrying the internal network (private-port services) (set by svc-tailscale; give wg0, a LAN NIC... to use another network)

SYSTEM_ADMIN_USER.description: Optional non-root sudo user to create

SYSTEM_SECRETS_FILE.description: Owner-only env file holding the credentials the steps generate

COCKPIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD_FILE.description: Owner-only env file holding COCKPIT_ADMIN_USER and COCKPIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD (the saved Cockpit/console login)
